fbd-crate-pulled.alt: Left: a 40 kg crate on a floor pulled to the right by a horizontal rope, moving at constant velocity. Right: its free-body diagram, a dot with four arrows starting on it: F_N, floor on crate, up; F_g, Earth on crate, down, the same length; F_T, rope on crate, right; F_f, floor on crate, left, the same length as F_T. Velocity is not drawn on the diagram.

fbd-tossed-ball.alt: A ball moving upward after leaving a hand. Its correct free-body diagram has a single arrow down, F_g, Earth on ball. A wrong diagram adds dashed arrows labeled force of the throw, v and F_net, none of which is a force exerted on the ball by another object.
